data.one_liner: Customizable animated cursor widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides an animated cursor that can be placed over any widget. It supports color, shape, duration, and border customization.
use_when: You want a custom cursor for a desktop or web Flutter app
You need animated cursor effects for interactive UI elements
avoid_when: You only need a static cursor or default system cursor
Your project targets only mobile platforms where custom cursors are not applicable
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget
weaknesses: Limited to cursor animation only, no state management
No built‑in support for complex interactions or events
